gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-biorhyme: Bruno Ace SC strings its letters out like beads on a long thread, each stroke a bent paperclip of uniform line. BioRhyme is the bookish serif here, its curves ending like brush strokes lifted early.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-biorhyme-expanded: A marker-like constant line runs through every Bruno Ace SC letter, with open apertures and wide, bead-on-a-thread spacing. The heading grabs the eye; BioRhyme Expanded rewards lingering over each gapped-out word.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-biz-udmincho: Bruno Ace SC makes rings of its o's, each wall a constant line, with letters strung wide and open. BIZ UDMincho sits beside it as a traditional, bookish serif with a shallow terminal curl.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-copse: Copse is a literary serif with daylight showing through every curved opening, set against Bruno Ace SC, whose line never varies. Bump Copse up a size so its openings can breathe.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-cutive: Marker-tip lines and beaded spacing define Bruno Ace SC, with open apertures throughout. Cutive, a literary serif tracked wide with generous c openings, is what makes the pairing memorable.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-david-libre: Bruno Ace SC keeps hairlines out entirely, its open, beaded letters drawn in a single unbroken line. And David Libre, a dignified serif with terminals that hang open, gives the heading something refined to rest against.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-enriqueta: Letters that read like outlines drawn in one width, set wide and open, make Bruno Ace SC instantly recognizable. Enriqueta brings chalky curves that stop short of closing, a dignified, literary warmth the heading lacks.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-fenix: Expressive and distinctive, Bruno Ace SC draws each glyph with one simple tip. While the heading grabs the spotlight, Fenix carries the editorial reading with curves that stop before turning inward.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-gentium-plus: Gentium Plus reads in a classic, refined voice, each c opening as wide as a pitcher's mouth. And the text settles into an unhurried rhythm that Bruno Ace SC, with its flat, unmodulated stroke, only sharpens by contrast.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-gowun-batang: Gowun Batang has a refined, literary voice, its terminals cut back to leave a big gap. But Bruno Ace SC, with no pinched joints or flared ends, makes the statement while the text serif does the quiet talking.
